method: Supabase MCP execute_sql — 1 combined aggregate (canonical 11-column dialable formula, nested-CASE local_helpers + people_who_help array guards to avoid the AND/OR non-short-circuit jsonb_array_length error, no-row check, placeholder-X regex) + 1 three-row prior-bug recheck. Aggregates only, egress-safe.
note_on_query_fix: The inline `jsonb_typeof(x)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(x)>0` CASE-WHEN form (used in a WHERE clause on prior days) threw '22023: cannot get array length of a non-array' when used inside a SELECT-list CASE today — Postgres does not guarantee left-to-right short-circuiting of AND inside a projected CASE. Fixed by switching to a nested `CASE jsonb_typeof(x) WHEN 'array' THEN ... ELSE false END` (the same pattern SKILL.md already mandates for people_who_help) for BOTH local_helpers and people_who_help, and wrapping the placeholder regex ORs in coalesce(...,false). Same aggregate methodology, safer SQL — no fields changed.
